candidates.source_name: TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) — notice search, SK country filter
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory EU-wide publication venue for above-threshold SK tenders; contract award notices name the winning vendor, value and CPV, making it the backbone for vendor/competitor mapping around SK banks, NBS, state financial institutions and payment infrastructure. Notices exist in both SK and EN.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the TED Search API (see separate candidate) with expert queries on country=SVK plus CPV families 30123400/48/50/66/72; fall back to the HTML search UI only for spot checks.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from TED developer docs
queries_used: TED europa Slovakia contract award notice banking ATM CPV 30123400

candidates.source_name: TED Search API v3 (api.ted.europa.eu) + bulk XML packages
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable, no-auth access to all TED notices: expert query syntax, up to 15,000 docs paginated (250/page), a stream/token mode without that cap, plus daily and monthly bulk XML packages. This is the only scalable way to build a longitudinal SK banking/payments CPV vendor dataset.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled API pulls against https://api.ted.europa.eu/{version}/notices/search with country and CPV facets; archive raw eForms XML, then parse award sections for supplier names/IDs.
queries_used: TED API "api.ted.europa.eu" search notices v3 documentation bulk download

candidates.source_name: Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie — Vestník verejného obstarávania (eForms)
candidates.why_relevant: SK national mirror/origin of the same eForms notices that flow to TED, published every business day with full-text and criteria search. Captures below-threshold contracts that never reach TED, and gives the SK-language wording of scope (bankomat, platobný terminál, kartové centrum) needed for the glossary.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-text keyword crawl of the Vestník search plus per-contracting-authority profiles (profil verejného obstarávateľa) for NBS and state-owned financial bodies; join to TED notice IDs.
queries_used: Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie vestník uvo.gov.sk oznámenie platobné terminály banka

candidates.source_name: Plán obnovy a odolnosti SR — official portal (planobnovy.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Slovakia's RRF portal; the 'Efektívna verejná správa a digitalizácia' component documents digitalisation investments, milestones and the IT methodology governing how RRF-funded IT is bought. Supplies the funding-side context and named calls that later surface as TED/UVO tenders touching financial-sector IT.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch component pages and PDF annexes on a quarterly cadence; extract investment/reform IDs and beneficiary institutions, then cross-search those names in UVO/TED.
queries_used: plán obnovy digitalizácia verejné obstarávanie Slovensko dodávateľ IT projekty

candidates.source_name: MIRRI SR — Ministerstvo investícií, regionálneho rozvoja a informatizácie (Plán obnovy + eurofondy sections)
candidates.why_relevant: Managing authority for SK digitalisation money and publisher of the Akčný plán digitálnej transformácie Slovenska 2023-2026 and IROP/Program Slovensko project lists. Names the state actors and programme lines whose procurement then identifies integrators also serving SK banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the plan-obnovy and zoznam-projektov subtrees; harvest project-list XLSX/PDF exports and strategy PDFs.
queries_used: plán obnovy digitalizácia verejné obstarávanie Slovensko dodávateľ IT projekty

candidates.source_name: ITMS2014+ verejná časť (EU funds project & beneficiary register)
candidates.why_relevant: Public face of the SK EU-funds monitoring system: implemented projects with signed NFP contracts, beneficiaries, indicators and activities. Gives the beneficiary trail (who received EU money for digitalisation) that pairs with the supplier trail in UVO/TED. Successor system ITMS21+ covers 2021-2027.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the public project search filtered on IT/digitalisation operational programmes; prefer any dataset export mirrored on data.gov.sk over HTML scraping.
queries_used: itms2014.sk ITMS2021 zoznam projektov prijímateľov eurofondy databáza export

candidates.source_name: Eurofondy.gov.sk — calls (výzvy) portal for Program Slovensko 2021-2027
candidates.why_relevant: Forward-looking view of EU-funded calls; digitalisation calls precede the procurements that name vendors, so this is the earliest reliable signal of upcoming SK IT/financial-infrastructure spend.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of the calls list with filters/keywords for digitalizácia, informatizácia, kybernetická bezpečnosť.
queries_used: itms2014.sk ITMS2021 zoznam projektov prijímateľov eurofondy databáza export

candidates.source_name: data.gov.sk — open datasets tagged 'eurofondy'
candidates.why_relevant: Slovak national open-data catalogue; aggregates machine-readable exports of EU-funds and procurement datasets published by ministries, avoiding fragile scraping of ITMS/UVO front-ends.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the CKAN-style dataset search/API to enumerate eurofondy and verejné obstarávanie datasets, then pull distributions directly.
queries_used: itms2014.sk ITMS2021 zoznam projektov prijímateľov eurofondy databáza export

candidates.source_name: EU Cohesion Open Data Platform
candidates.why_relevant: Commission-run platform with ESIF/cohesion allocations, spend and beneficiary datasets per member state, including Slovakia. EN-language, structured, and comparable across countries — useful for sizing SK digitalisation envelopes that feed banking-adjacent IT projects.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Socrata-style dataset API pulls filtered on country=SK and thematic objective 'digital'; refresh semi-annually.
queries_used: opentender.eu Slovakia procurement data OR "cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu" beneficiaries Slovakia

candidates.source_name: Opentender.eu — Slovakia portal (Government Transparency Institute)
candidates.why_relevant: Re-publishes TED plus the SK national portal (ÚVO) as cleaned, structured contracting data covering 35 jurisdictions, including below-threshold SK contracts. Fastest route to supplier-level aggregation and market-share style views without building the ETL ourselves; also carries integrity indicators.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the SK country dataset (OCDS-style) via the portal/OCP Data Registry entry; treat as derived data and validate a sample against original TED notices.
queries_used: opentender.eu Slovakia procurement data OR "cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu" beneficiaries Slovakia

candidates.source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP)
candidates.why_relevant: Where EBRD clients post procurement, prequalification, shortlisting and contract-award notices for EBRD-financed contracts. Award notices name suppliers — the IFI-side equivalent of TED awards for banking/fintech modernisation projects.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll public notice listings filtered by country; register only if listing pages prove gated. Cross-check against ebrd.com procurement-notices pages.
queries_used: EBRD procurement notices Slovakia bank digital transformation supplier list

candidates.source_name: EBRD — Slovak Republic country page and project/news feed
candidates.why_relevant: Country-level record of EBRD activity in SK, and the EBRD Digital Approach frames which financial-sector digitalisation projects get funded. Project summary documents typically name the client financial institution and the scope, from which technology partners can be inferred or followed up.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of the SK country page, project summary documents and the news feed; keyword filter on bank names, digital, payments.
queries_used: EBRD procurement notices Slovakia bank digital transformation supplier list

candidates.source_name: EBRD corporate procurement (SMART by GEP)
candidates.why_relevant: EBRD's own supplier-facing platform for goods/works/consultancy. Relevant secondarily: consultancy assignments on SK financial-sector reform are contracted here, and consultant identities reveal advisory competitors in the region.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the public opportunity summaries on ebrd.com rather than the gated GEP platform.
queries_used: EBRD procurement notices Slovakia bank digital transformation supplier list

candidates.source_name: EIB — Financed projects database (loans) and pipeline
candidates.why_relevant: Searchable register of EIB-financed and pipeline projects with country filter; SK entries include intermediated credit lines through commercial banks, naming the financial intermediary. Establishes which SK banks carry EU-backed programmes — a partnership and account-mapping signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Filter loans and pipeline lists on country=Slovakia and sector=credit lines/services; capture promoter names and signature dates on a quarterly cadence.
queries_used: EIB projects Slovakia financed list bank credit line "European Investment Bank" Slovenská sporiteľňa VUB

candidates.source_name: EIF — Slovakia country page and guarantee-deal news
candidates.why_relevant: EIF publishes each InvestEU/EFSI guarantee signed with a named SK financial intermediary (SZRB, ČSOB, Komerční banka for CZ+SK, etc.), with volumes and expected beneficiary counts. Directly identifies which SK banks are running EU-backed lending products — a strong partnership and product-roadmap indicator.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the SK country page plus /InvestEU/news and /what_we_do/guarantees/news archives filtered on Slovak/Slovakia; build an intermediary-by-year table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball across EIF news archive
queries_used: EIF Slovakia InvestEU guarantee agreement Slovak bank SIH Slovak Investment Holding beneficiaries list

candidates.source_name: Slovak Investment Holding (SIH) / SZRB — fund-of-funds financial instruments
candidates.why_relevant: SIH, 100% owned by SZRB, manages over EUR 1bn of EU shared-management instruments and channels them through commercial banks. Its disclosures and the fi-compass case study reveal which SK financial institutions act as intermediaries and what systems/reporting obligations they must support.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read the fi-compass case study PDF and SIH's own site; snowball to SIH annual reports and its calls for financial intermediaries.
queries_used: EIF Slovakia InvestEU guarantee agreement Slovak bank SIH Slovak Investment Holding beneficiaries list

candidates.source_name: European Commission — Investment Plan for Europe: Slovakia results page
candidates.why_relevant: Consolidated EFSI scoreboard for SK: counts of EIB projects and EIF agreements with intermediary banks/funds and mobilised investment. Useful as a cross-check and as a pointer into the underlying EIB/EIF deal records.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch for baseline figures; low refresh need (legacy 2019-2024 priority pages).
queries_used: EIB projects Slovakia financed list bank credit line "European Investment Bank" Slovenská sporiteľňa VUB

candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo financií SR — international financial institutions (EIB/EBRD relations)
candidates.why_relevant: SK Ministry of Finance is the shareholder-side counterpart for EIB/EBRD and states that EIB projects in SK are published; a stable pointer to official SK positions, guarantees and which state entities borrow.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl (semi-annual); use mainly to resolve institutional names and SK-language equivalents.
queries_used: EIB projects Slovakia financed list bank credit line "European Investment Bank" Slovenská sporiteľňa VUB

candidates.source_name: EU Funding & Tenders Portal (SEDIA)
candidates.why_relevant: Central register of EU-institution grants and tenders plus funded project records (participants, coordinators, budgets). Captures SK financial-sector participants in EU programmes (e.g. digital/cyber calls) that never appear in national procurement.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the portal's project/participant search filtered on country=SK; prefer the CORDIS/Funding portal bulk datasets over UI scraping (the screen is a JS SPA).
queries_used: opentender.eu Slovakia procurement data OR "cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu" beneficiaries Slovakia

candidates.source_name: Partnerská dohoda / ÚVO institutional page (EU-funds procurement rules for SK)
candidates.why_relevant: Explains how ÚVO oversees procurement of EU-funded contracts in SK and links the ITMS/partnership-agreement machinery to the procurement bulletin — the connective tissue between the funding trail and the vendor trail.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read to map institutional roles; snowball its outbound links to ITMS and ÚVO.
queries_used: Úrad pre verejné obstarávanie vestník uvo.gov.sk oznámenie platobné terminály banka

candidates.source_name: EURACTIV.sk — digitalisation section (state IT procurement scrutiny)
candidates.why_relevant: SK-language journalism that scrutinises large state IT tenders (e.g. a EUR 68m system criticised by experts), often naming bidders, prices and controversies that procurement notices state neutrally. Useful for context, controversy flags and vendor-reputation signals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/section crawl with keyword filters (obstarávanie, dodávateľ, IT systém, banka); store links and short summaries only, never full text.
queries_used: plán obnovy digitalizácia verejné obstarávanie Slovensko dodávateľ IT projekty

candidates.source_name: Open Contracting Partnership Data Registry — Slovakia and TED publications
candidates.why_relevant: Registry entries describe exactly what SK and TED contracting datasets contain, their coverage, format and download endpoints — the fastest way to choose a stable ingestion path instead of guessing at portal exports.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read of publication 88 (Slovakia) and 150 (TED) to capture download URLs and field coverage; re-check annually.
queries_used: opentender.eu Slovakia procurement data OR "cohesiondata.ec.europa.eu" beneficiaries Slovakia

negative_findings.description: General web search could not surface a specific SK contract award notice under CPV 30123400 (ATM/banking machinery) or related banking CPVs; search engines index TED notices poorly and inconsistently.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only generic TED how-to guides and unrelated non-SK notices returned. Confirms that CPV-level SK banking procurement must be queried inside TED itself or via its API, not via general search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets the collection design: TED Search API with explicit country+CPV facets is required; keyword web search is not a viable discovery channel for this cell.

negative_findings.description: No public, per-transaction beneficiary list was found for EIF InvestEU/EFSI guarantees to Slovak intermediaries (SZRB, ČSOB, Komerční banka).
negative_findings.result_summary: EIF publishes intermediary-level deals (volumes, expected number of SMEs) but not final-beneficiary registers for SK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Limits the granularity of the funding trail: we can map which banks run EU-backed products, but not which end clients, so downstream vendor inference must rely on procurement rather than beneficiary data.

negative_findings.description: A WebFetch of https://ted.europa.eu/en/simap/faq returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a moved/renamed page hypothesis, not as evidence TED's SIMAP area is dead — the developer/reuser pages under the same host were found via search and remain the correct entry point.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents that one bad fetch is not a liveness verdict and that the reusers' corner URL should be used instead.

negative_findings.description: EBRD project procurement notices largely live behind ECEPP and corporate procurement behind SMART by GEP, both of which encourage or require supplier registration.
negative_findings.result_summary: Public notice listings appear to exist on ebrd.com, but full notice detail and award history may need an account.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: IFI supplier trails for SK financial institutions may be only partially collectible without registration; plan a manual/periodic review rather than automated ingestion.

negative_findings.description: No Slovak-language terminology was available for the IFI layer (EIB/EBRD/EIF procurement), because those institutions publish about Slovakia almost exclusively in English.
negative_findings.result_summary: SK-language searching was applied successfully to ÚVO, plán obnovy, ITMS and eurofondy, but IFI procurement had no meaningful SK vocabulary beyond institution names (Európska investičná banka, Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language coverage for this cell is inherently asymmetric: national/EU-funds layer is SK-rich, IFI layer is EN-only. Collection queries should reflect that split.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact CPV code set relevant to SK banking/payments (ATM hardware, cash handling, card personalisation, core banking software, payment processing services, cash-in-transit) has not yet been fixed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and validate a CPV shortlist (30123400 ATM, 30144200, 48xxx software families, 66xxx financial services, 72xxx IT services, 79xxx) by running TED API facet counts for country=SVK and inspecting top awards.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified list yet of SK contracting authorities in scope (NBS, state banks SZRB/Exportno-importná banka, Slovenská pošta, ministries and state IT bodies) that procure banking/payment technology.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate profil verejného obstarávateľa pages on uvo.gov.sk for these entities and pin their authority IDs for repeatable TED/ÚVO queries.

coverage_gaps.description: The Slovak Central Register of Contracts (Centrálny register zmlúv) was not searched in this pass; it holds the actual signed contract texts behind awards, including annexes and prices.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add crz.gov.sk as a follow-up discovery target and test whether contract documents for IT/banking awards are downloadable in bulk.

coverage_gaps.description: SK e-procurement execution platforms (JOSEPHINE/proebiz, EVO/IS EVO, eZakazky, Tendernet) that host tender documentation referenced by ÚVO notices were not evaluated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess each platform's public document access and whether tender specifications (which reveal incumbent systems) are downloadable without an account.

coverage_gaps.description: Commercial SK banks (Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, 365.bank) are not contracting authorities, so their vendor selections never appear in TED/ÚVO.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on EIB/EIF intermediary disclosures, vendor press releases and case studies for the private-bank layer; flag this as structurally out of reach for the procurement trail and hand to the vendor-website/press cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Whether EBRD ECEPP award notices for SK are visible without registration, and whether the EU Funding & Tenders SPA exposes a stable participant export, remain untested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a deterministic access probe on both before committing to automated ingestion.

brief: The EU-level procurement and funding trail for SK banking/payments rests on three stacked layers. The mandatory-disclosure layer is strongest: TED plus its no-auth Search API and bulk XML packages, mirrored nationally by the ÚVO Vestník in Slovak, which together give CPV-coded, vendor-named award data including below-threshold contracts. The EU-funds layer (planobnovy.sk, MIRRI, ITMS2014+/ITMS21+, eurofondy.gov.sk, cohesiondata and data.gov.sk) gives the money-side context and beneficiary names for digitalisation projects, while third-party aggregators (Opentender.eu, OCP registry) offer a cleaned shortcut worth validating against originals. The IFI layer (EIB project register, EIF Slovakia guarantee disclosures, EBRD country pages and ECEPP) names intermediary banks and some suppliers but is English-only and partly registration-gated, and commercial SK banks remain structurally invisible to this trail — that blind spot must be covered by vendor-side sources.
